### 9. TIME FORMATTING UTILITIES

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Clientloop/lib/utils/time.ts` (lines 1–43)

- **hoursFromNow(iso)** — Returns signed hours difference from ANCHOR (2026-04-10T12:00:00Z)
- **formatSlaChip(slaDueAt)** — Returns `{ label, tone }`:
  - < 0h: "Xd overdue" or "Xh overdue" (tone: breached)
  - < 24h: "in Xh" (tone: warning)
  - >= 24h: "in Xd" (tone: ok)
- **formatRelative(iso)** — Returns relative time:
  - < 1h: "just now"
  - < 24h: "Xh ago"
  - < 7d: "Xd ago"
  - >= 7d: "Xw ago"
